name: Hero: Starburst Barrage gains a stack from Arcane Barrage (#10722)
contract: Starburst Barrage 284222 reads 'Casting Starfire and Arcane Barrage reduce channel time of your next Starburst', stacking up to 3 times. Arcane Barrage 44425 is a Hero ability (CharacterAdvancement 3603/40857, class type 5 = class 10). A level 60 Hero with the passive casts Arcane Barrage at a dummy: the Barrage aura 284220 and the Mystic Enchant rank aura 979138 must each gain one stack. Issue #10722.
